messages:
jamal: Thinking out loud 1: lightweight "pinfile" generator + a quick rollback alias for emergencies. want a head-nod before i sketch UX + manifest.

sophie: explain pinfile? is it just a small manifest that pins images, configs, and rollout knobs?

jamal: yes. canonical tiny file we store with release metadata. example: `pinfile.yaml`. fields: service, image, git-sha, desired-replicas, traffic-split, rollback-strategy. can be created from a CI release or manually.

priya: useful. can we auto-generate from a k8s deployment or our image registry?

jamal: plan: ` /deploy pinify --from=deployment/auth --out=pinfile-334.yaml ` will snapshot current live state and open a draft in the PR branch. also `--from=build/1234` to snapshot CI artifact.

alex: and quick rollback? how would that be safe for oncall?

jamal: alias `/deploy quick-rollback <pinfile>` or shorthand `/rk <release-id>` that re-applies a pinfile but with safety gates: preflight lint, confirmation, and optional staged rollback. default is staged: revert canary first, then 10% steps every 5m unless `--immediate` is specified (requires 2 approvals).

sophie: show example commands pls

jamal:```
/deploy pinify --from=deployment/auth --message="hotfix pin" --out=pinfiles/pin-334.yaml
/deploy apply --pinfile=pinfiles/pin-334.yaml --dry-run
/deploy quick-rollback pin-334 --staged
/rk pin-334 --immediate --reason="prod incident"
```

release-bot: [automated] created release entry r-2026-334 and attached pinfiles/pin-334.yaml. Audit id: AUD-335-998.

priya: preflight lint? what checks?

jamal: basic lint rules: required fields present, image tag pinned (no floating :latest), rollback-strategy defined, and traffic-split sums to 100. extra checks: ensure smoke_test exists if changing auth service, and validate KMS policies if secret rotation is present. Missing critical fields block apply.

alex: UX: oncall needs a single button to run quick-rollback from Slack or PagerDuty. can we wire a Slack action to trigger `/rk` with a prefilled pinfile?

jamal: yep. deploy-bot will post a compact card with `Rollback (staged)` and `Rollback (immediate)` buttons. clicking immediate triggers a 2nd approval modal if required. all actions logged back to the release entry.

sophie: how about rollforward after rollback? sometimes rollback causes regressions. need easy re-deploy of the previous release.

jamal: pinfile has `history` block. when pinify runs, we append previous pinfile refs. then `/deploy rollforward <pinfile>` re-applies the next pin in history. also we store a short reason and who triggered.

priya: tests? can we simulate staged rollback in staging with traffic generator to validate our staged timing?

jamal: yes `./tools/simulate-rollback --plan=pinfiles/pin-334.yaml --stage=staged` will run a dry simulation and produce a timeline with expected error budgets and p95 delta. will add CI job that runs smoke tests post-apply.

deploy-bot: [automated] preflight results for pin-334: lint=PASS, smoke=PASS (staging), estimated-impact: p95 +20ms, tokens ~2.1k. :white_check_mark:

alex: add `--explain` flag that prints the exact k8s patch and traffic changes. useful for blameless postmortem.

jamal: good call. also adding `--ops-link` to attach a short runbook link to the release entry that shows rollback/playbook and TL;DR checklist.

sophie: locking: we should prevent concurrent `quick-rollback` on the same service. mutex in the release entry?

jamal: yes, sagas will own a lock per service. attempting a second rollback will show `blocked` with a link to the active saga. manual override allowed with `--force` but requires 2 approvers.

priya: data retention: how long keep pinfiles and audit logs? our compliance folks want 1 year by default, archive to cold storage after 90 days.

release-bot: [automated] policy note: default retention = 365d. pinfiles older than 90d auto-archive to cold S3 prefix `archive/pinfiles/`.

jamal: next steps: I'll prototype the pinify CLI, add Slack action handlers, and a simple UI card. planning a short demo Fri. sophie, can you review the lint rules? alex, can you sketch the Slack card layout? priya, feasibility of staging simulation?

alex: on it. i'll draft a compact card with `Apply (dry-run)`, `Apply`, `Rollback (staged)`, `Rollback (immediate)` and small footprint summary.

sophie: will review lint rules tomorrow.

priya: will check simulation infra and report back by Thursday.

jamal: thanks team. will open a WIP PR and link it here when ready. :rocket:

deploy-bot: [automated] pinned follow-ups: JAMAL -> WIP PR, SOPHIE -> lint review, ALEX -> card mock, PRIYA -> sim infra check. Due: 2026-03-25. :calendar:
